meaning:
πρεσβεύω
(πρέσβυς),
1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2Co.5:20, Eph.6:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
